description: Bitwise primitive atoms for non-negative integer-like values. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/bitwise — verified bitwise primitives'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only primitives available in std/core.mm and keep contracts Z3-friendly.

atoms.name: bit_and
atoms.description: Bitwise AND over non-negative values, bounded by each operand.

atoms.name: bit_shift_left
atoms.description: Left shift by a non-negative amount, with caller-provided bounds keeping the result within i64 range. Operand bounds mirror std/core.mm (checked_mul) and std/math/pow.mm (pow_small) so the result cannot overflow signed i64.

atoms.name: bit_shift_right
atoms.description: Right shift by a non-negative amount, bounded by the original value.
